div.div: 2 تَجْفِيَةٌ [inf. n. of جفّى] signifies, in Persian, جفاء فرمودن [app. as meaning The ordering one to act, or to treat another, coarsely, roughly, rudely, &c.]. (KL. [Accord. to Golius, as on this authority, “ i. q. جَفَا, sign. injuria affecit; duriter et inique tractavit: seu transit. ejus. ”])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
